```{r}
# Define ordered factor levels for ae_term
ae_term_levels <- c(
  "URTI: Nasopharyngitis", "URTI: Sinusitis", "URTI: Sinusitis, acute", "URTI: Sinusitis, bacterial", 
  "URTI: Rhinitis", "URTI: Rhinitis, allergic", "URTI: Rhinitis, viral",
  "URTI: Pharyngitis", "URTI: Pharyngitis, bacterial", "URTI: Location not noted", "URTI: Location not noted, viral", 
  "LRTI: Bronchitis", "LRTI: Bronchitis, viral", "LRTI: Pneumonia", "LRTI: Pneumonia, viral", "LRTI: Location not noted", 
  "RTI: Location not noted", "RTI: Location not noted, viral",  
  "Cough", 
  "Other respiratory harms"
)

# Define ordered factor levels for time_frame
time_frame_levels <- c("0-6 months", "7-12 months", "13-24 months", "> 24 months")

# For forest plots, we are restricting to outcomes with at least 3 studies
dat_fig <- final_summary_glp %>%
  filter(Number_of_Studies >= 3) %>%
  mutate(ae_term = factor(Outcome, levels = ae_term_levels, ordered = TRUE),
         time_frame = factor(Timepoint, levels = time_frame_levels, ordered = TRUE),
         upper = round(Upper_CI * 100, digits = 1),
         lower = round(Lower_CI * 100, digits = 1),
         mean = round(RD_Estimate * 100, digits = 1),
         rd_ci = paste0(mean, " (", lower, ", ", upper, ")"),
         Number_of_Studies = as.character(Number_of_Studies),
         highlight = (Upper_CI < 0 & Lower_CI < 0) | (Upper_CI > 0 & Lower_CI > 0),
         Drug = "GLP-1 and GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists"
         )

# For forest plots, we are restricting to outcomes with at least 3 studies
dat_fig_v2 <- final_summary_glp_v2 %>%
  filter(Number_of_Studies >= 3) %>%
  mutate(ae_term = factor(Outcome, levels = ae_term_levels, ordered = TRUE),
         time_frame = factor(Timepoint, levels = time_frame_levels, ordered = TRUE),
         upper = round(Upper_CI * 100, digits = 1),
         lower = round(Lower_CI * 100, digits = 1),
         mean = round(RD_Estimate * 100, digits = 1),
         rd_ci = paste0(mean, " (", lower, ", ", upper, ")"),
         Number_of_Studies = as.character(Number_of_Studies),
         highlight = (Upper_CI < 0 & Lower_CI < 0) | (Upper_CI > 0 & Lower_CI > 0),
         Drug = "GLP-1 and GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists"
         )

# Set the upper and lower bounds for the x-axis
upper_limit <- 6
lower_limit <- -10
by_interval <- 2
```


# Function to output figure
```{r}
make_forestplot <- function(data, suffix, figpath = "./", fig_height = 14, fig_width = 8.5,
                            show_footnote = TRUE,
                            footnote_text = "**Statistically significant risk difference (95% CI does not include 0). \nAbbreviations: URTI: upper respiratory tract infection; LRTI: lower respiratory tract infection; RTI: respiratory tract infection.") {
  # \n GLP-1 and GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists includes liraglutide, semaglutide, and tirzepatide.
  # Sort data
  data_ordered <- data %>%
    arrange(Drug, ae_term, time_frame)
  
  forest_list <- list()
  
  for (drug in unique(data_ordered$Drug)) {
    drug_data <- data_ordered %>% filter(Drug == drug)
    
    # Drug-level summary row
    forest_list[[length(forest_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      label = drug,
      Number_of_Studies = "",
      mean = NA, lower = NA, upper = NA,
      rd_ci = "",
      is.summary = TRUE,
      highlight = FALSE
    )
    
    for (ae in unique(drug_data$ae_term)) {
      ae_data <- drug_data %>% filter(ae_term == ae)
      
      # Outcome-level summary row
      forest_list[[length(forest_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        label = paste0("  ", ae),
        Number_of_Studies = "",
        mean = NA, lower = NA, upper = NA,
        rd_ci = "",
        is.summary = TRUE,
        highlight = FALSE
      )
      
      # Actual data rows
      ae_rows <- ae_data %>%
        mutate(
          label = paste0("    ", Timepoint),
          is.summary = FALSE,
          highlight = (Upper_CI < 0 & Lower_CI < 0) | (Upper_CI > 0 & Lower_CI > 0),
          rd_ci = paste0(round(RD_Estimate * 100, 1), " (",
                         round(Lower_CI * 100, 1), ", ",
                         round(Upper_CI * 100, 1), ")"),
          mean = round(RD_Estimate * 100, 1),
          lower = round(Lower_CI * 100, 1),
          upper = round(Upper_CI * 100, 1)
        ) %>%
        select(label, Number_of_Studies, mean, lower, upper, rd_ci, is.summary, highlight)
      
      forest_list[[length(forest_list) + 1]] <- ae_rows
    }
  }
  
  # Combine and finalize
  forest_df <- bind_rows(forest_list) %>%
    mutate(label = ifelse(highlight, paste0(label, " **"), label))
  
  labeltext <- cbind(
    Label = forest_df$label,
    `# Studies` = forest_df$Number_of_Studies,
    `Risk Difference % (95% CI)` = forest_df$rd_ci
  )
  
  labeltext <- rbind(
    c("Drug/Outcome/Study durations", "# Studies", "Risk Difference % (95% CI)"),
    labeltext
  )
  
  data_matrix <- forest_df %>% select(mean, lower, upper)
  data_matrix <- rbind(c(NA, NA, NA), data_matrix)
  
  is_summary <- c(TRUE, forest_df$is.summary)
  
  # Create the plot
  forest_plot <- forestplot(
    labeltext,
    mean = data_matrix$mean,
    lower = data_matrix$lower,
    upper = data_matrix$upper,
    is.summary = is_summary,
    xlab = "Risk Difference % (Drug-Placebo)",
    xticks = seq(lower_limit, upper_limit, by = by_interval),
    xlim = c(lower_limit, upper_limit),
    lineheight = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    boxsize = 0.5,
    txt_gp = fpTxtGp(
      label = gpar(cex = 0.8),
      xlab  = gpar(cex = 0.8, fontface = "bold"),
      ticks = gpar(cex = 0.6, fontface = "plain", col = "black")
    ),
    fn.ci_norm = forestplot::fpDrawDiamondCI,
    fn.ci_sum = forestplot::fpDrawSummaryCI,
    col = fpColors(box = "steelblue", line = "darkgrey", summary = "steelblue"),
    lwd.ci = 2,
    lwd.zero = 2,
    lwd.xaxis = 2,
    lwd.summary = 2,
    xlog = FALSE
  )
  
  # Save the plot
  # filename <- paste0(figpath, "forest_rd_", suffix, ".tiff")
  # 
  # tiff(
  #   filename = filename,
  #   width = fig_width,
  #   height = fig_height,
  #   units = "in",
  #   res = 400,
  #   compression = "lzw"
  # )

  filename <- paste0(figpath, "forest_rd_", suffix, ".jpeg")
  jpeg(width = fig_width, 
       height = fig_height, 
       units = 'in', 
       res = 550, 
       quality = 100, 
       filename = filename)
  
  
  print(forest_plot)
  
  # Conditionally add footnote
  if (show_footnote && !is.null(footnote_text) && footnote_text != "") {
    grid.text(footnote_text, 
              x = unit(0.01, "npc"), y = unit(0.02, "npc"), just = "left", 
              gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))
  }
  
  # Close the device
  dev.off()

  # Read the JPEG only after the graphics device has completed the file.
  library(magick)
  img <- image_read(filename)

  image_write(
  img,
  path = filename,
  density = "550x550")
}


```

# GLP-1 : includes lira, sema, tirz
```{r}
make_forestplot(dat_fig, suffix = "glp", figpath = figpath)
```

# GLP-1 (v2): includes lira and sema
```{r}
make_forestplot(dat_fig_v2, suffix = "glpv2", figpath = figpath,
                footnote_text = "** Statistically significant risk difference (95% CI does not include 0). \n GLP-1 receptor agonists includes liraglutide and semaglutide.")
```

library(magick)

img <- image_read(paste0(figpath,"forest_rd_glp.jpeg"))

image_write(

  density = "300x300"
)
